column2: The ambition was admirable, but the finish left something to be desired.
Nothing showy, but the orchestra's quality is beyond doubt.
The applause would not die down after the last note, and three encores were demanded.
Afterwards the audience poured into the streets as if in a fever. Tonight will be talked of for a long time.
